verdict.rationale: Marketplace payments are a fair question for a payments and billing platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers single-merchant features: Polar acts as Merchant of Record and lets you withdraw your own balance. Nothing shows onboarding third-party sellers, splitting a payment between parties, or paying out to multiple sellers. The payout documentation describes an adjacent feature for the account holder's own funds, not marketplace payouts.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller
